DOP: caraka m. and mf (-ikā) n. [ cf S. , BHS caraka, AMg caraa, caraga], 1. ( m. ) one who goes about or roams; a wandering ascetic ; S I 106, 31* (~ā bahu bheravā bahū atho ḍaṃsasiriṃsapā bahū; Spk I 173, 28 : ~ā ti sīhavyagghādikā sañcaraṇasattā); Ja V 395, 11* (yo sabbalokaṃ ~o mahāmuni dhamme ṭhito Nārado saccanikkamo, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be sabbalokaccarito); Ap 37, 16 (~ā tāpasā c’ eva caranti mahiyā tadā); 358, 13 (addhikā pathikā sabbe yācakā ~ā bahū upagacchanti te niccaṃ bhikkhayantā mamaṃ ghare, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce varakā); — ifc see vana-; — 2. ( mfn. ) (one) who practises or performs; one who acts habitually ; — ifc see attha- ( sv attha 2 ), heṭṭhā-.

1 cāraka m. [ ts ], a prison ; Vism 479, 4 ( in long cpd ) = Vibh-a 32, 11 ; Vism 495, 8 (tatiyasaccaṃ pana yasmā nisaddo abhāvaṃ rodhasaddo ca ~aṃ dīpeti, tasmā abhāvo ettha saṃsāracārakasaṅkhātassa dukkharodhassa sabba-gatisuññattā); Mhv 46:40 (uparājaṃ gahetvāna Dāṭhāsivaṃ khipāpayi ~e); 51:127 (rājā pi disvā taṃ kuddho khippaṃ pakkhippa ~e); Sadd 873, 26 (attani pavesite satte carati bhakkhatī ti ~o, corabandhanacārako ca saṃsāracārako ca).
NCP: masculine one who goes about or roams; a wandering ascetic.
